papers.title: Microstructure of γ-titanium aluminide processed by selective laser melting at elevated temperatures
papers.first_author_affiliation: German Aerospace Center, Institute of Materials Research, Linder Hoehe, 51147, Cologne, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Joachim Gussone
corresponding_authors.affiliation: German Aerospace Center, Institute of Materials Research, Linder Hoehe, 51147, Cologne, Germany

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究γ-TiAl合金的选区激光熔化显微组织，完全没有涉及生物医学植入物或应力屏蔽问题
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical implant context, no porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, no mechanical testing for biomedical applications

summary_zh.motivation: 研究γ-TiAl合金SLM加工时的微观结构演变
summary_zh.method: 通过控制SLM过程中的基板温度来观察显微组织变化
summary_zh.result: 发现高温下形成细小均匀的γ相组织
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM和XRD分析验证微观结构特征

summary_en.motivation: This paper investigates the microstructure evolution of γ-TiAl alloy during selective laser melting at elevated substrate temperatures.
summary_en.method: The study varied substrate temperature during SLM and characterized resulting microstructures using SEM and XRD.
summary_en.result: Elevated temperatures promoted the formation of fine and homogeneous γ-phase microstructure.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization via electron microscopy and X-ray diffraction confirmed phase composition and grain morphology.

papers.title: The Influence of Hip Rotation on Femoral Offset Following Short Stem Total Hip Arthroplasty
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic and Trauma Surgery, University Hospital of Cologne, Cologne, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Christoph Kolja Boese
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic and Trauma Surgery, University Hospital of Cologne, Cologne, Germany

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦于髋关节旋转对短柄全髋置换术后股骨偏距的影响，属于临床影像学研究，未涉及生物力学建模或应力分析。
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanical modeling, no stress/strain/micromotion quantification, no FEA, no comparison of intact vs implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究髋关节旋转对短柄全髋置换术后股骨偏距测量的影响
summary_zh.method: 在不同旋转角度下通过X线片测量股骨偏距
summary_zh.result: 髋关节旋转显著改变股骨偏距测量值，需标准化旋转角度
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床患者X线片数据的统计比较

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how hip rotation affects the measurement of femoral offset following short stem total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Radiographic measurement of femoral offset under controlled hip rotation angles in a cohort of patients.
summary_en.result: Hip rotation significantly influences femoral offset values, emphasizing the need for standardized rotation in postoperative assessment.
summary_en.validation: Clinical radiographic study with statistical analysis of repeated measurements.
